metadata.title: Seedance 2.5 Examples: AI Video Showcase & Use Cases
metadata.description: Explore Seedance 2.5 examples, demo ideas, official showcase references, commercial concepts, and prompt structures for cinematic AI video.

hero.title: Seedance 2.5 Examples
hero.description: A responsible guide to Seedance 2.5 demo ideas, Seedance 2.5 showcase references, and Seedance 2.5 video examples: use official material for capability context, then turn a clear shot brief into a testable prompt on a supported provider.
hero.tip: Examples demonstrate a workflow, not a guarantee. The provider, model version, input rights, settings, and current rollout determine the actual result.

introduce.title: How to read a Seedance 2.5 example
introduce.description: A useful example explains the intended shot, references, camera path, timing, output target, and verification criteria instead of showing an unexplained demo reel.

items.title: Start with the creative goal
items.description: Define whether the clip is a product ad, story beat, previsualization, social post, educational scene, or visual effect test.

items.title: Describe the shot
items.description: Write the subject, action, camera, lighting, pace, sound, aspect ratio, and end state in one coherent brief.

items.title: Label the references
items.description: State which image, video, audio, or clay render controls identity, motion, composition, or style.

items.title: Document the result
items.description: Record the provider, version, settings, prompt, output dimensions, and known failures so the example is reproducible.

benefits.title: Seedance 2.5 examples, showcase, and demo categories
benefits.description: These categories connect common “demo” and “showcase” searches to a practical production question.

items.title: Cinematic one-take scene
items.description: Plan a 30-second narrative with setup, movement, turning point, and a clear final image.

items.title: Product or advertising concept
items.description: Use controlled lighting, close-ups, product geometry, readable composition, and a safe commercial reference set.

items.title: Reference-led character scene
items.description: Combine identity anchors with a short action and explicit continuity constraints.

items.title: Clay-render or green-screen test
items.description: Use spatial blocking or background replacement to test a complex production idea before a full shoot.

features.title: Prompt templates for Seedance examples
features.description: Replace the bracketed choices with your own material and confirm that the target provider supports the requested references and edits.

items.title: Story prompt
items.description: A single continuous shot of [subject] in [setting]. From [time] to [time], [action]. Camera [movement], light [quality], sound [direction], ending on [final image].

items.title: Product prompt
items.description: Show [product] on [surface]. [Interaction] reveals [detail]. Use [lens/camera], [lighting], [background], [aspect ratio], and no unrequested logos or text.

items.title: Reference prompt
items.description: Use @Image 1 for [identity/composition], @Video 1 for [motion], and @Audio 1 for [sound]. Preserve [constraints] while changing [intended edit].

items.title: Social prompt
items.description: A [duration]-second vertical clip for [platform]. Start with [hook], show [action] in [timing], keep [subject] centered, and end with [call to action].

items.title: Quality checklist
items.description: Confirm subject identity, motion continuity, camera path, audio timing, text readability, dimensions, watermark, and commercial rights.

items.title: Iteration note
items.description: Change one variable at a time: prompt, reference, duration, camera, resolution, or audio. Keep the successful version as a baseline.

faq.title: Seedance 2.5 Examples FAQ
faq.description: Clear answers for the most common Seedance searches and workflows.

items.question: Where can I see official Seedance 2.5 examples?
items.answer: Start with the official ByteDance Seed model and announcement pages, then check the provider surface where you plan to generate. Third-party demo reels may use different settings or versions.

items.question: Can I use Seedance 2.5 for advertising examples?
items.answer: It can be evaluated for advertising concepts where a supported provider exposes the needed workflow. Confirm product rights, likeness permissions, music rights, and commercial plan terms.

items.question: Does this page provide downloadable official demo videos?
items.answer: No. It provides prompt structures and evaluation guidance. Use the official showcase or the provider’s current interface for authorized demo assets.

items.question: Can Seedance 2.5 make 30-second examples?
items.answer: Official materials describe up to 30 seconds per generation with extensions. The actual limit depends on the provider, account, mode, and current API settings.

items.question: Why does my example not match a showcase?
items.answer: Showcases may use different model versions, references, settings, post-processing, or selection criteria. Reproduce the documented setup and inspect the output rather than expecting identical pixels.

cta.title: Build an example you can reproduce
cta.description: Choose one shot category, document the inputs and settings, and test it on a provider that explicitly supports the workflow.
